_comment: icraft #35 Tetra material display names. tetra.material.<key>.name = full name shown in the workbench material slot; .prefix = the adjective Tetra prepends to the assembled item name (e.g. 'Ignitium Sword'). Without these, Tetra falls back to a raw Title-Cased key (e.g. 'Dd warden', 'Fa tyr', 'Undergarden cloggrum'). Covers the icraft_tetra_materials datapack set. Vanilla Tetra builtins (iron/gold/diamond/netherite) are intentionally omitted -- they are replace:false stat overlays that already inherit Tetra's own lang. Keys grouped by source datapack category.
